exposure: type of operative vaginal delivery (vacuum vs. forceps)
outcome: ratio of vacuum to forceps deliveries
cohort: Women with term pregnancies (greater than 37 weeks of gestation) who underwent an operative vaginal delivery in a large tertiary hospital between 2008 and 2021.
finding: Over a 15-year period, operative vaginal delivery rates declined, and although vacuum remained the favored instrument, forceps-assisted deliveries became more prevalent.
mod_finding: The ratio between vacuum and forceps-assisted deliveries significantly decreased from 7.06 in 2008 to 2.39 in 2021, indicating a rise in forceps-assisted deliveries.
